test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mobiles are tablets.

All tablets are laptops.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some laptops are mobiles.

II. Some mobiles are laptops.

III. All mobiles are laptops.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
Explanation:

We draw a Venn diagram from the given statements:

Some mobiles are tablets.

All tablets are laptops.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/681dae4ebf4e5784929f2164ae9398ef347cc7799caf62f45809bb7ec18ec90f.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:
